written.myAnswer: Digital technologies such as websites, social media and e-commerce platforms allow entrepreneurs to promote and sell their products online to customers around the world.

An e-commerce platform is an online system for setting up a store, displaying products, managing orders and inventory, processing payments, and supporting customers. It gives businesses a convenient way to sell online and reach a wider, potentially global, market.

Market research tools help a business understand customer needs, competitors and market trends. Online marketing tools—such as SEO, social media, content and email marketing—promote the business and attract customers. An e-commerce platform displays products and helps manage orders, payments and customer service. Used together, they help a business make informed decisions, reach customers online and complete sales.
